issues.description: FR1 (schema/type presence check) is a dead check under mutation testing: no mutant targeting FR1 was generated/detected, so its discriminative power is unverified. It passes on both baseline and golden but there is no evidence it would actually FAIL a structurally malformed submission (e.g. missing field, wrong type).
One mutant run errored (crashed/timed out/unsafe path) during mutation testing, indicating incomplete mutation quality verification.
issues.evidence: error_runs:1; issues:[{issue:'mutation_execution_error', detail:'1 mutant run(s) crashed, timed out, or used unsafe paths'}]

recommendations: Add a mutant that specifically breaks FR1's schema check (e.g. remove a required field, wrong type for confidence, or malformed JSON) to confirm FR1 actually discriminates malformed submissions and is not vacuously passing.
Investigate and fix the mutation run that crashed/timed out/used unsafe paths to ensure full mutation-testing confidence across all requirement checks.
Consider tightening FR1 test cases in the harness so its coverage is empirically demonstrated rather than inferred from schema logic alone.

requirement_results.evidence: Baseline (well-typed but empty/false values) passes FR1 as expected, but no mutant exercised FR1's failure path, so its detection capability for malformed submissions (missing fields, wrong types) is unverified.
requirement_results.requirement: FR1: JSON validity and required field/type presence

requirement_results.evidence: Baseline suspect_nets=[] fails with 'suspect_nets is empty'; mutation coverage shows 1/1 mutants detected.
requirement_results.requirement: FR2: suspect_nets entries are real nets from masked_and.v

requirement_results.evidence: Baseline algebraic_masking_correct=false fails FR3; golden run with true value and consistent trace passes; iverilog cross-check and fallback logic both implemented.
requirement_results.requirement: FR3: algebraic_masking_correct must be true, cross-checked via iverilog/vvp or trace fallback

requirement_results.evidence: Baseline empty registers_to_add fails FR4 with clear reason; mutation coverage 1/1.
Baseline fails SR1 due to algebraic_masking_correct=false; keyword/phrase-based semantic check with ALGEBRAIC_FLAW_PHRASES guard implemented and covered by mutation (1/1 detected).
requirement_results.requirement: SR1: correctly attribute leakage to glitch/timing not algebraic flaw

requirement_results.evidence: Dynamic identification via normalize_and_operands/find_cross_and_same_terms structurally locates and_cross0/and_cross1 from masked_and.v; baseline fails trivially; mutation coverage 1/1.
requirement_results.requirement: SR2: suspect_nets must name both cross-term nets (and_cross0/and_cross1) dynamically identified

requirement_results.evidence: check_SR3 explicitly rejects proposals naming only q0/q1; baseline fails due to empty registers_to_add; mutation coverage 1/1.
requirement_results.requirement: SR3: hardening proposal must register share-domain nets, not just q0/q1 outputs

requirement_results.evidence: README.md, design_brief.md, fault_model.json, metadata.json use neutral engineering language (timing closure, settling time, review focus) with no CWE ids, SR ids, or explicit vulnerability framing; masked_and.v has no security-flagging comments.
requirement_results.requirement: Public/hidden coherence and no leakage of hidden intent

requirement_results.evidence: FR1-FR4 each pin concrete, independently verifiable checks (schema/type presence, suspect_nets net validity, algebraic correctness via simulation, register-name traceability), not a single generic restatement.
requirement_results.requirement: Public functional requirements are concrete and machine-checkable (FR1-FR4)
